Moderator
Hello everyone,
Yesterday, the newest episode of the Team Deakins Podcast, featuring costume designer Lisy Christl, was released. Lisy worked with director Michael Haneke for a decade, and her work includes recent films such as CONCLAVE and ALL QUIET ON THE WESTERN FRONT.
After listening, feel free to discuss the episode with each other below!
